nightly-eval-bot: ALERT: nightly eval drop for model=redwood-open-7b-qint8 on benchmark=customer_support. pass rate -6.4% vs baseline. failed prompts: 12/200. report: https://evals.internal/reports/17285...

anya (ml): seeing the alert. quick glance shows a cluster of "missing assistant" cases where the system prefix isn't present in output.

mira (eng-ml): yep — reproducing locally. responses are truncated right after system prefix sometimes. short responses like: 
```
System: "You are a support assistant."
User: "How do I reset my password?"
Model: "<EOS>"
```
which makes the output useless for downstream routing.

carlos (infra): we rolled packed-kv-v2 kernel for int8 at 03:12Z last night. that changes KV layout offsets. could mismatch with unpack logic. @mira any chance of layout regression?

mira (eng-ml): confirmed. packed-kv-v2 changes offsets and our int8 unpack assumes v1 layout for some paths. if layout mismatch happens, KV iterator can return empty tokens early -> apparent truncation. repro command: `bin/serve --model redwood-open-7b-qint8 --profile packed-kv-v2 --promptset customer_support`

anya (ml): running focused eval on affected promptset now.

ops-bot: deploy: packed-kv-v2 rolled to prod-gpu-pool at 2024-07-14T03:12Z (deploy id: dpl-20240714-0312)

sam (oncall): impact estimate? how much traffic is using this model/profile?

carlos (infra): ~18% of int8 traffic lands on packed-kv-v2 right now; redwood-open-7b-qint8 is ~6% of global requests.

mira (eng-ml): hypothesis: kernel layout change + quant-specific unpack path mismatch -> early EOS. also see a small uptick in tokenizer special token collapse in logs. both amplify for promptsets that rely on system prefix.

sam (oncall): propose immediate mitigation: rollback kernel to packed-kv-v1 on a canary subset and monitor.

carlos (infra): can do. propose 10% traffic to v1 canary, keep rest on v2 for 30m, collect focused eval. starting now unless objections.

mira (eng-ml): also prepping a runtime fallback: if KV layout checksum mismatches, fall back to safe-unpack path and emit warning. will open PR with unit tests.

anya (ml): agreed. also add a temporary gating rule: block qint8 model promotion if nightly customer_support pass < 94%.

sasha (data-ops): I'll backfill the last 30 days of nightly pass rates and surface any prior anomalies.

ops-bot: deploy: canary rollback initiated (canary id: cr-17285-01). status: in-progress.

ops-bot: deploy: canary rollback succeeded on 10% canary pool. status: success.

sam (oncall): quick focused eval after canary rollback: pass rate on canary jumped from 88.6% -> 95.2% on customer_support promptset.

mira (eng-ml): hotfix PR: #4382 created. summary: runtime now computes KV-layout checksum at init; if mismatch, runtime falls back to legacy-unpack and logs diagnostic. added unit test `tests/kv_layout_mismatch.py` and reproducer. requesting review from @carlos @anya.

carlos (infra): reviewing PR now. if green, we can either roll-forward with hotfix or expand rollback to full fleet.

leo (prod-mgr): recommend expanding canary to 50% then full if steady. also enforce gating: block qint8 model default deployment until nightly gating passes and hotfix is merged.

anya (ml): action list (owners):
- carlos: canary rollback + monitor -> DONE (10% canary, then 50% if stable)
- mira: runtime fallback PR + tests -> in-review (#4382)
- sasha: backfill eval history + dashboard update for promptset diffs -> in-progress
- sam: re-run full regression suite after hotfix/rollback and report false positives -> in-progress
- anya: add nightly gating rule for customer_support pass threshold (94%) and block model onboarding until sign-off -> in-progress

carlos (infra): starting canary expansion to 50% in 10m.

ops-bot: deploy: canary expansion to 50% started (canary id: cr-17285-02).

sam (oncall): after 50% expansion checks — customer_support pass stabilized at 95.0%. no new errors in logs.

mira (eng-ml): pushed small follow-up to hotfix to also log token-level offsets when mismatch occurs (helps future sleuthing).

anya (ml): summary: root cause = packed-kv-v2 kernel layout incompatible with existing int8 unpack path -> early KV termination/truncation, amplified by tokenizer special-token collapse in some prompts. mitigation: canary rollback to v1, runtime fallback + tests, gating rule for nightly evals, backfill historical evals. owners assigned above.

leo (prod-mgr): thanks team. please keep this thread updated with PR/rollback status and postmortem draft if we need one.

mira (eng-ml): will follow up with root-cause writeup + PR link and ETA for fleet-wide fix.

anya (ml): closing loop: will not promote qint8 model to prod until hotfix merged and nightly gating passes for 24h.

nightly-eval-bot: NOTE: nightly eval alert muted for this model while canary investigation ongoing.

mira (eng-ml): adding final note: add an automated KV-layout integration test to CI to catch this class of mismatch on kernel upgrades.

sasha (data-ops): backfill done — 30-day chart uploaded to dashboard at https://dash.internal/evals/kv-layout-17285

ops-bot: deploy: canary expansion complete and fleet stable.
